title: Check generated data freshness: manifests and library/candidates.json against the schema
description:
`library/candidates.json` (336 KB) and the sample manifests (200-330 KB each) are generated ML output checked into git. Nothing checks them against `schema/sample-manifest.schema.json` in CI; `test_manifests.py` does but skips when samples are absent and never runs in CI. The `contract/` files are checked by `contract:check`.

Done when: a CI step validates every tracked manifest and `candidates.json` against the schema without needing audio, and fails on a schema change that the data does not follow.
